Subject: Co-sell bundle: clarifying listing evidence & SKU mapping for AWS + GCP

Jordan / CloudBridge team —

Great speaking yesterday. To keep momentum for the co-sell listing and bundle SKU in both AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace, we need to align on a concise evidence handoff and a final SKU/entitlement map. Quick ask from our side: can you confirm the following by EOD Wednesday?

- Signed partner agreement (we have draft, but need counter-signed).
- Technical evidence: architecture diagram, SOC2 excerpt, performance validation (p99 latency) for the bundle.
- SKU mapping: primary Redwood bundle SKU, CloudBridge addon SKU, and reseller/resale pricing guidance.
- Demo credentials & a short demo video (2–3 mins) showing provisioning flow for the bundle in AWS and GCP.

I've attached our co-sell checklist with the Redwood fields that Marketplace teams will look for (cb_co-sell_checklist.xlsx). Karthik / Camila — looping you in for any clarifications on evidentiary format or entitlement naming.

If we can get the artifacts and a quick sync with your marketplace ops person, we can hit the internal publishing window next week. Proposed slot: Thu 4/5 10:00 PT (30 minutes). Is that workable?

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Partnerships, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Stephanie — helpful note and clear checklist. We can deliver most of that by Wednesday. Quick clarifications:

- Agreement: our legal will counter-sign the partner addendum by EOD Thursday — can you confirm the final signature block we should use?
- Performance data: we have a sandbox run for the bundle with end-to-end p95/p99 numbers; file will be csv export. Is a single-run snapshot acceptable or do you need sustained-run artifacts?
- SKU naming: we try to avoid underscores in marketplace SKUs — we’ll propose names in the attached draft.

We can join Thu 4/5 10:00 PT; adding our Marketplace Ops lead, Maya Ratan, to the thread so she can speak to listing requirements on GCP. Attaching: cb_proposed_sku_map.pdf (small).

Jordan Park

Date: Wed, 04 Apr 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell bundle: clarifying listing evidence & SKU mapping for AWS + GCP

Jordan — quick technical notes from the Redwood listing side:

- Evidence: Marketplace teams accept a single validated run if it includes test harness details (input sizes, sequence lengths, quantization profile). CSV snapshot is fine as long as columns are labelled. If you can include the inference config (model name, batch size, seq len distribution), we can stitch into our performance appendix.
- SOC2 excerpt: a redacted PDF with control IDs and audit period is fine; no raw logs required.
- Entitlements: for the bundle we need three entitlement IDs: Redwood-bundle (consumption), CB-addon (feature flag), and reseller-credit (if reseller pricing applies). Please provide GUID-style identifiers or let us generate canonical IDs.

Stephanie — I’ll draft the entitlement ID schema and attach the template (gcp_entitlement_matrix.csv). Jordan/Maya, please populate and return.

—Karthik
Principal Product Manager, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference
[attachment: gcp_entitlement_matrix.csv]

Subject: Re: Co-sell bundle: clarifying listing evidence & SKU mapping for AWS + GCP

Hi all — Maya here (Marketplace Ops). Small correction: I’m with CloudBridge (marketplace ops), not Asteria — apologies for the confusion in my signature below.

We reviewed the checklist. A few practical points from the AWS / GCP side:

- AWS: the public listing requires the performance snapshot plus a one-paragraph usage note describing typical workload and limits. We prefer p95 and p99; include both.
- GCP: you must provide an entitlement matrix (the template Karthik attached works). GCP also asks for a short integration diagram (PNG).
- Demo credentials: we cannot accept long-lived shared creds. Please provide time-limited demo credentials or a recorded provisioning walkthrough.

We can join Thu 4/5 10:00 PT to go through the final artifact checklist. For legal, send the counter-signed addendum to partners@cloudbridge.io and we’ll route internally.

Thanks,
Maya Ratan
Marketplace Ops Lead, CloudBridge
